subject: Procurement kickoff: stakeholder roster, cadence, and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@alcyontech.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@alcyontech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff: stakeholder roster, cadence, and onboarding checklist

Hi Tom / Alcyon procurement team —

Thanks for agreeing to move forward with Redwood. To get the vendor setup and PO process moving, can we schedule a short kickoff (30-45m) this week to run through:

- Stakeholder roles (who owns PO, legal review, technical handoff)
- Timeline for PO issuance and vendor enrollment
- Required onboarding deliverables (SOW/PO, W9, security questionnaire)
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and success criteria

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 8/3 10:00–10:30
- Tue 8/3 15:30–16:15
- Wed 8/4 11:00–11:45

I've attached our vendor onboarding form and our standard PO template so you can review before the call. If you have a preferred MAP template, feel free to send it and we'll incorporate.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), PO_template.xlsx (Excel)

Goal for the call: align on owners, target PO date, and confirm any redlines that need early legal attention.

Quick asks for the thread: please confirm which slot works and who from Alcyon will join (procurement lead + legal if any).

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Vendor Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@alcyontech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@alcyontech.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@alcyontech.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: stakeholder roster, cadence, and onboarding checklist

Olga —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can do Tue 8/3 at 15:30 PDT (slot 2). I'll be joined by Alicia Gomez (procurement manager) and our finance systems lead — I'll confirm the finance name before the call.

Couple quick items:
- We prefer to see a brief MAP (milestones + owners) beforehand so we can validate timelines with Legal and Finance.
- Regarding the PO, our standard process requires a vendor tax form (W-9) and a signed supplier agreement for any >$50k commits. If you have a template supplier agreement, please attach.
- Can you also confirm whether Redwood requires any additional vendor security evidence aside from the questionnaire (e.g., SOC2 report or ISO cert)?

I'll route the proposed slots internally and confirm attendees. 15:30 works for now.

Tom Ellis
Head of Procurement | AlcyonTech
tom.ellis@alcyontech.com | +1 (617) 444-2299

Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: stakeholder roster, cadence, and onboarding checklist

Tom / Olga —

Confirmed on our side for Tue 8/3 15:30 PDT (we reserved 45m to leave room for questions). Draft agenda below — happy to iterate:

1) Intros & objective (5m)
2) Procurement/PO path & target dates (10m)
   - Who issues PO, expected lead times, preferred PO format
3) Compliance & security asks (10m)
   - Questionnaire turnaround, SOC 2 evidence, encryption/KMS notes
4) MAP review: milestones + owners (10m)
   - Target PO signed date, vendor activation in Redwood, initial support handoff
5) Action items & next steps (5m)

MAP (short):
- 8/3: Kickoff call (owners: Olg a/Alcyon procurement)
- 8/6: Vendor returns onboarding form, W-9, and any required security artifacts (owner: Alcyon)
- 8/10: Legal review complete / PO issued (owner: Alcyon Legal & Finance)
- 8/12: Vendor activated in Redwood Dedicated (owner: Redwood Vendor Ops)

Success criteria: PO issued by 8/10, completed onboarding form + W-9, and no open legal redlines requiring >5 business days.

Attachments: redwood-map-draft.docx (MAP + milestone table)

Neha — can you scan the MAP for legal flags? Dev — is there any additional onboarding info we should call out for activation (IP allowlists, contact for integration)?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 06 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: stakeholder roster, cadence, and onboarding checklist

All —

Small update from our side: Alicia will be our procurement lead on the call and Jose Ramirez (finance systems) will join to confirm PO flow. Legal will listen but likely not required for the kickoff unless a material change to the supplier agreement is requested.

We reviewed the MAP draft — looks reasonable. A few clarifications:
- For the SOC2 evidence, we need either a SOC2 Type II report or an attestation letter; can you indicate which Redwood will provide?
- We'll upload the W-9 during the call if that helps speed up PO prep.
- Please send the DocuSign link (or equivalent) for the supplier agreement; we prefer electronic signature.

I'll have Alicia send the attendee list and a calendar invite for Tue 8/3 15:30 PDT (you might see it perform a time shift if your calendar is in a different zone).

DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.example.com/tx/ABC1234

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the call.

Tom Ellis
Head of Procurement | AlcyonTech
